title: Fix a bug with rsc_table where it requires more columns than specified in the documentation
description:
There is a bug in `rsc_table()` where it requires more columns to be present than the function is checking for, because each specified column in `reactable()` must be present in the `content` passed to the function.

To fix:
Removed all the columns that had `show = FALSE` and added a defaultColDef to hide any unspecified columns.

title: Some modernization of github actions
fix!: use public thumbnail image API
description:
Small code change but lots of updates to generated files.

The downside to this approach is that there wasn't a simple way to detect (in utils.js) which version of Connect the server is on, so for versions of Connect older than 2024.09.0, the thumbnails won't be available in this version--you will need to use the previous release. Given the slow pace of development on this project, I thought that might be an acceptable tradeoff.

title: Changes for upcoming htmlwidgets 1.6 release
description:
The upcoming [htmlwidgets 1.6 release](https://github.com/ramnathv/htmlwidgets/blob/master/NEWS.md) happens to break the unit tests that check the class of `htmlwidgets::shinyWidgetOutput()` (the new release will add some additional classes). Updating those expectations to use `expect_match()` instead of `expect_equal()` will get them passing with the new release. 

Also, with htmlwidgets 1.6, `rsc*Output()` now throws a warning because they return a `tagList()` (which won't work for the new `fill` parameters). And since it seems like you don't need to use `tagList()` here and can instead just include the extra dependencies in the `<div>`, I made that change as well

title: warn rather than err when the server does not provide version

additionally, test-connect.R is no longer sensitive to incoming environment variables.

Given a Connect server configured with `Server.HideVersion = true`:

```
connectwidgets::connect()
#> RStudio Connect API Client: 
#>   Server: XXXXXX
#>   API Key: YYYYYY
#> Warning message:
#> In private$validate() :
#>   Unable to validate that the RStudio Connect server version >= 1.8.8.3; the server did not provide its version.
```

fixes #63
